title: Why Not? Mango Passion 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Mango Passion from Why Not? is a heady tropical blend that will whisk you away to exotic shores from your very first taste. Experience the sweet, luscious, juiciness of fresh Mango combined with the more intense sweetness of Passionfruit in one exquisite vape After all, Why Not? Shortfill bottles from Why Not? E-liquids offer the ideal way to personalize your nicotine levels to your exact preference. Each bottle comes with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 20ml of space for two nicotine shots, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills not only offer extended longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours but also serve as an economical and convenient option. Thanks to their higher VG content, they're the perfect match for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils, ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production. Make your vaping more efficient and enjoyable by stocking up on your preferred e-liquids in Shortfills. Why Not? are a range of 100ml shortfills that are made in the UK. They’ve paired only the very juiciest fruit flavours in each blend for a deliciously natural tasting vape experience. Why Not? shortfills come in 100ml shortfill bottles with space for one or two nicotine shots to let you tailor your e-liquid’s nicotine strength to your exact preference.
